entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi... yes, hello. I have this VeloBand Pulse thing, and I... I think I need to return it. I'm a bit confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. Just to understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
Oh, it works fine, I think. It's just... not for me. The thing is, I tried to return it last week. I think it was my ninth day having it. But there was a big website error.
A website error, you said? Can you tell me more about that?

Yes, the whole return portal seemed to be broken. It just said 'system down' and I couldn't get any further. I took a screenshot on my phone because I was worried. I couldn't print a label or anything. I just got overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you. Please don't worry about the website issue. Let me just pull up your account... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. And I can see you received it 18 days ago.
Is that too late? Because of the error, I couldn't do it sooner.
Not at all! You have nothing to worry about. I'm looking at our return policy right here, and all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? That's... a relief. I thought I had missed it. So I can send it back?

Absolutely. I've just initiated that return for you. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email on file right now. And since you're a VIP member and had that trouble with our site, I've also added a free expedited shipping credit to your account for your next order.
Wow, thank you so much. You've made this so much easier.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
